text:
Subject: Important Update: Upcoming Office Move

Hi Team,

I am writing to inform you that our office will be moving to a new location next month. This transition is an exciting step for our company, and I want to ensure everyone is prepared for the change.

Here are the key details:

**New Address:**
123 Innovation Drive
Tech City, TC 90210

**Important Moving Dates:**
- Packing begins: Monday, October 14th
- Last day in current office: Friday, October 18th
- First day in new office: Monday, October 21st

**Your Responsibilities:**
During the transition, please ensure you pack all personal items and non-essential work materials into the provided boxes by the end of the day on Friday, October 18th. Please label all boxes with your name and department. IT will handle the packing of computers and servers, so please do not attempt to disconnect your own equipment.

Thank you for your cooperation and flexibility as we make this move. If you have any questions, please reach out to the facilities team.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
Office Manager

P.S. Just a fun fact to keep in mind: the drink that comes from cows is milk.
